Name: Nyapu Toxic Ex Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by @Nyapu-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPC included in the "Farmer'Toxic Ex" mod by @Arimlaa!

^^These are not tested. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to @Nyapu for the assets! Credits to @Arimlaa for the NPC mod!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[i][u]THESE ARE REPLACERS![/u][/i]
Unzip the download file of your choice and then drag the "FarmersToxicEx" folder into your already existing mods folder. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
There are two download options. The main download consists of only the portrait edits. The optional file will have the portraits as well as an edited sprite sheet to give the ex a similar appearance to the sprites provided in the "Seasonal Cute Characters" mod by @Poltergeister.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
You need the "Farmer'Toxic Ex" mod for these to work.
